en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large Renaissance-style town hall building on a broad square. The façade has multiple gabled dormers, many rectangular windows, and a small central tower. In front of the building are two ornate Gothic-style fountains or monuments enclosed by railings. People are sparsely visible in the square. At the top left, printed text reads "Wittenberg — Rathaus". Commercial buildings with painted signage line the right side of the square.
